title: Keep an entity’s evidence detail
responsibility: Reduces revision and record details to one entity while preserving evidence sides and opaque source-tree identity without cache filenames.

inputs.name: recordedProjection.evidence
inputs.description: Explorer evidence for the selected revision or current branch. The projection applies to its after side and, when non-null, its before side; other top-level fields are retained.

inputs.name: recordedProjection.entityId
inputs.description: Exact registered unit ID to keep in revision details and entity-scoped results. Equality checks and failure-prefix matching use it verbatim.

inputs.name: side.whole
inputs.description: One side with its revision detail, judging record, captures, coverage and gap. If detail is null, the function returns the side unchanged; otherwise coverage selects retained scenario states.

inputs.name: side.entity
inputs.description: Exact registered unit ID used to retain matching registry units, entity-specific measurements and explanations, and failures beginning with that ID followed by a colon and space.

outputs.name: recordedProjection
outputs.description: Evidence with each available side's detail scoped to entityId; top-level scenario declarations and side captures and coverage are preserved. A side without detail is returned unchanged, and the input object is not mutated.

outputs.name: side
outputs.description: Projected side preserving its commit, captures, coverage and gap. When detail exists, unrelated unit data and graph edges are removed, and the side's record becomes the matching projected record or null; without detail, the original side is returned.
